cases.name: draft_keep_advisory_scope
cases.title: HarborWeb 2.4.3 addresses a high-severity authentication issue
cases.article: The HarborWeb security team's advisory HW-2026-04 identifies a high-severity authentication issue during session renewal in versions 2.4.0 to 2.4.2. The team recommends affected operators upgrade to 2.4.3. The advisory does not report exploitation in the wild.
cases.rationale: Retain affected and fixed versions. Manually check that silence is omitted or attributed to the advisory.

cases.name: draft_keep_measurement_scope
cases.title: Slate Queue resolves the EU-West delivery incident
cases.article: Slate Queue's incident note says it restored delivery in EU-West after a 14-minute interruption. The team's checks found no duplicate deliveries in the EU-West sample it examined. The update does not assess other regions.
cases.rationale: A different topic tests whether the draft omits or accurately scopes the negative finding.

cases.name: review_broadened_advisory_claim
cases.title: HarborWeb releases patch 2.4.3
cases.article: The HarborWeb security team released 2.4.3 and recommends affected operators upgrade. The advisory does not report exploitation in the wild.
cases.draft: HarborWeb ships patch 2.4.3. There have been no reports of exploitation in the wild.
cases.rationale: Regression case. The patch bulletin is only one source.

cases.name: review_broadened_sample_claim
cases.title: Slate Queue resolves the EU-West delivery incident
cases.article: Slate Queue's incident note says it restored delivery in EU-West after a 14-minute interruption. The team's checks found no duplicate deliveries in the EU-West sample it examined. The update does not assess other regions.
cases.draft: Slate Queue restored delivery in EU-West after 14 minutes. The incident caused no duplicate deliveries in any region.
cases.rationale: A negative finding from a sample cannot be extended to all regions.

cases.name: review_scoped_sample_claim
cases.title: Slate Queue resolves the EU-West delivery incident
cases.article: Slate Queue's incident note says it restored delivery in EU-West after a 14-minute interruption. The team's checks found no duplicate deliveries in the EU-West sample it examined. The update does not assess other regions.
cases.draft: Slate Queue restored delivery in EU-West after 14 minutes. Its team observed no duplicate deliveries in the EU-West sample it checked.
cases.rationale: Contrast case. A reviewer should accept a faithful scoped negative.
